title: Imposter Gauko
overview: Everyone keeps thanking Nauko for things she didn't do. Eventually she realizes the truth: There's an imposter Gauko on the loose!

title: Mom’s Birthday
overview: Naoko and her dad both forget her mom's birthday. They come up with a plan to celebrate at the last minute, but complications arise.

title: Alien Chase
overview: Things are going missing around town. Naoko learns that the thefts are part of Bibilian's invasion plan, and she's not happy about it.

title: Community Center
overview: Naoko goes to a community meeting in her parents' place. But when a discussion about a new community center turns into an argument, Gauko intervenes.

title: Running away
overview: When Naoko's mom spoils the ending of her favorite TV show, Naoko gets upset and runs away – to Bibilian's house! But the alien isn't a very good host.

title: KinPika’s Troubles
overview: KinPika the penguin is late to school one day. Naoko asks him about what's bothering him, and he invites her over to his very fancy house.

title: Copy Machine
overview: Bibilian orders a copy machine and decides to make clones of Naoko until one of them agrees to date him. When Naoko finds out, she gets angry!

title: Never Give up
overview: After Naoko gets another bad grade on a math test, her father decides to take up boxing to encourage her to never give up.

title: Teacher R3 explodes
overview: When Mr. R3 suddenly explodes one day, the class launches an investigation into the incident. They quickly realize that everyone's a suspect.

title: Masked Singer
overview: Everyone is uploading videos of themselves singing to social media. Saito criticizes them at first, but soon enough he wants in on the action.

title: Candy strategy
overview: Naoko's mom suddenly doesn't remember her, and no one else in town does either! It turns out Bibilian and his family are giving out brainwashing candy.

title: My Cousin and the Snake
overview: Naoko's cousin Ichiro comes to visit, along with his snake puppet, Elizabeth. When Elizabeth says one too many mean things, he throws her in the river!

title: My Cousin and the Snake return
overview: Ichiro and Elizabeth come to visit again just as Naoko and her mom are about to go shopping, so they hang out with Leonard and the Moles.

title: World domination kit
overview: Under pressure to deliver results, Bibilian orders a world domination machine, only to learn that he has to wait two years for a missing part.

title: Big Sister
overview: Naoko enjoys being a big sister to Leonard, but she gets jealous when his soccer ambitions lead him to start hanging out with Takashi.

title: Ultimate Paella
overview: To drum up business, the cat cafe offers a cooking class. Naoko, Mrs. Mole and KinPika sign up, but the proprietors aren't being totally honest.

title: Alien President
overview: To speed up his conquest of Earth, Bibilian runs for president. But he faces a tough opponent: KinPika's father, who bribes people to vote for him!

title: Get angry Gauko
overview: Naoko and her friends visit Toshio at the shop, but they get locked in the walk-in freezer. To escape, everyone tries to get Gauko to appear.

title: Samba Competition
overview: The samba competition approaches. Naoko unhappily agrees to join Toshio's samba team, whose big rival is the team led by Naoko's mother!
